ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Impact of the Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the child care funding freeze on low-income families and child care providers in Minnesota.
questions: How many families are affected by the funding freeze?
What are the long-term implications for child care providers?
ideas.insight: By analyzing data and public records, we can uncover the human impact of the funding freeze and hold accountable those responsible for the decision.
